name: ihaart
expr: [a, d]    = haart(x8, 1);    xr_l1 = ihaart(a, d); [a, d]    = haart(x8);       xr_full = ihaart(a, d); xr_p1 = ihaart(a, d, 1); xr_p2 = ihaart(a, d, 2); [a, d]    = haart(xi, 3, 'integer'); xr_int = ihaart(a, d, 'integer'); xr_intp1 = ihaart(a, d, 1, 'integer'); xr_intp2 = ihaart(a, d, 2, 'integer'); [a, d]    = haart(M, 1);     xr_m  = ihaart(a, d); [a, d]    = haart(M);        xr_mp = ihaart(a, d, 1);
comment: Sig: xrec = ihaart(a, d[, level[, integerflag]]). Inverse Haar 1-D DWT. Default level=0 (lossless reconstruction). When level=K (in [0, Nlevels)) the K finest detail bands d{1..K} are zeroed BEFORE reconstruction (xrec stays full-length). Inverse formulas: noninteger uses (a±d)/sqrt(2); integer uses lifting x[2k]=a[k]-floor(d[k]/2), x[2k+1]=x[2k]+d[k]. d MUST be real even when a is complex (MATLAB validateattributes on D). d may be a plain matrix at level=1 or a length-Nlevels cell array. Vector-shaped a returns column; matrix returns matrix. Verified: level=1, full multi-level, partial reconstruction (zero-out 1 and 2 bands), integer mode + partial, matrix full + partial.
